description: Host-conforming wall. Attach to a SEGMENT (from Segment Properties): the wall takes the segment's length and its CANVAS thickness as the footprint — there are no plan-size parameters here (thickness comes from the segment). `height` extrudes that band upward from `base`, and `color` fills it in both the 2D plan and the 3D view. Because the footprint is the host segment, this object has no `geometry` block; the renderer builds the wall band from the host segment + these params. Unlike Door/Window objects it does NOT cut an opening in the segment.
